evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: We talked to a lot of customers everyday. Some of their concerns about moving our movers not arriving on time or damages to their Adams. Are any of this, or concerns as well?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said no to the two concerns offered; Joanna pivoted immediately to logistics without pressing deeper on the packing/unpacking service interest the customer raised.
evidence_quotes.value_days: We can actually save up to probably you know $10,150 if you're doing it on Sunday to Thursday. But if Saturday really is the best time, especially work wise, then, we should be okay too.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: No deposit payment on payment is only upon completion of the move. If you're ready to go ahead with the booking, just respond to the email, give us a call, whichever works. (Softened ask with built-in outs; no explicit rate lock statement; customer deferred decision to email review.)

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently—addresses, property types, room counts, furniture specifics, fragile items, parking—and asked both packing and box count questions, setting up an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: Step 6 was entirely skipped: Joanna never asked a genuine final concerns check before closing, which means she missed the customer's stated interest in packing/unpacking tradeoffs and lost the chance to confirm any remaining concerns before asking for the booking.
